what: SCORES-T (2026-10-23): the scratch forward's 16-row groups with their rows in the vector lanes -- on the AVX-512 instance under the exp contract, a scratch strip (INFER-ATTN's: a forward no backward reads) runs a 16-row group at a time: its queries transposed once into a d x 16 panel, its scores 16 x 16 blocks with one accumulator a key, the softmax on the blocks with none of the three register transposes a 16 x 16 block took, the context reading a key's eight rows' probabilities side by side -- every value as it was. Measured on the committed tree against the tree before it: the cross-build hashes, the attention forward with both units in one process beside an A/A control, bcir_decoder_forward in one process, and the GEO study's attention model's inference built as the study builds it, against PyTorch; and the design runs: the prototype's phases and A/B -- its stored forward, its groups transposed out to p's rows, measured and not taken -- and the backward a phase at a time.
host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.30GHz, 4 vCPU (AVX-512F, AVX512-BF16 and -FP16, AMX), 2 MiB of L2 a core, 260 MiB of L3 -- the host the session moved to on 2026-10-23; Linux 6.18; clang 18.1.3, gcc 13.3.0; Python 3.11.15, torch 2.13.0+cu130 (CPU), numpy 2.2.6; OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE
